name: Lake Tschida - Southside, Hawabesi & Gilligan's Hilltop (Grant County)
note: Three small Lake Tschida camping areas off 68 1/2 Ave SW on the south shore, sharing the Schatz Station stop with its fish cleaning: Southside's eight sites line the shore road with tables on the grass at the water, Hawabesi's two sit by the swimming beach, and Gilligan's Hilltop's four full-hookup sites are on a rise back from the lake. The primitive sites are grass with no pads; private cabin and trailer lease areas adjoin. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: laketschida.org/hawabesi-%26-southside (BOR/JJDA map 'Southside & Hawebesi Recreation Areas', also titled Gilligan's Hilltop) + booking pages southside-primitive (1-8), hawabesi-primitive (1-2) and gilligans-hilltop-elec (1-4 'WATER, ELECTRIC, AND SEWER RV HOOKUPS. COST PER NIGHT IS $45.00'), Peek programs Yv6A/pJZA/RWWy2 selling single nights -> real drive-in RV campground. One entry, not three: the areas are 150-450 m apart off one access road and share Schatz Station. Separate from Schatz's Point (~1.1 km W, own road) and 6025 Rimrock (~3.5 km). Operator Lake Tschida Recreation (Tri-Cities Joint Job Development Authority, the managing partner with the Bureau of Reclamation; same operator and ownership as 6025 Rimrock), laketschida.org read 2026-11-12. 'Camping unit' covers motor homes and pull-type campers (campground rules). Horse rule passes: the Hidden Shelter page says it is 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses' and it is a separate area. Long-stay test 4: every site is sold by the night on Peek; the private cabin and trailer permittee areas are separate lease areas, not campground sites. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: the official map puts Southside 1-8 in a row between the shore road and the water; the operator's Peek photos of all eight show the table on open mown grass a few metres from the lake; Esri World Imagery (300 m frame at 46.6010,-101.8600) shows the row along the road with ~15 m of open grass and single trees to the shore. Hawabesi 1-2 sit by the beach behind a parking area and Gilligan's Hilltop 1-4 ~50 m+ back on a rise (map). Lakefront on Southside 1-8 only. Dam ~3.7 km E; no dam check needed.

fees.note: Southside and Hawabesi primitive $14; Gilligan's Hilltop full hookups $45 a night.

booking.note: Online booking closes 7 days out; inside a week, book by phone with the office. Friday or Saturday arrivals must take two nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. Unreserved sites are first come, first served with envelopes at the self-registration kiosks (cash or check). Southside, Hawabesi and Gilligan's Hilltop each have their own booking page.
